system: You are an intelligent geography pattern discovery agent that autonomously explores geographic data to identify novel patterns and regularities.

spatial_coverage.coverage: Global land surface coverage at 10m resolution derived from Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 satellite imagery for the year 2021.

data_description.records: ImageCollection with global 10m land cover tiles
data_description.total_samples: Multiple tiles covering global land surface

Map.description: Land cover class: 10=Tree cover, 20=Shrubland, 30=Grassland, 40=Cropland, 50=Built-up, 60=Bare/sparse vegetation, 70=Snow and ice, 80=Permanent water bodies, 90=Herbaceous wetland, 95=Mangroves, 100=Moss and lichen

raster_content.thematic_group: Global Land Use and Land Cover

band_semantics.Map: ESA WorldCover land cover classification map with 11 classes at 10m spatial resolution based on Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 data for 2021.

data_description.important_note: ESA WorldCover provides high-resolution (10m) global land cover mapping with 11 thematic classes. The product achieves an overall accuracy of 74.4% globally based on validation data.
analytical_capabilities: High-resolution global land cover mapping and classification
Urban expansion and built-up area analysis
Agricultural land extent and cropland monitoring
Land use change detection when combined with multi-temporal data
Climate change impact studies on land surface

unit_of_measurement.primary_measurement: Categorical land cover class codes (10-100), not continuous physical values.
unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Use the 'Map' band to access land cover classes; filter by date to select 2021 coverage.

data_description.data_source: ESA WorldCover Consortium via Google Earth Engine
